match.title: Nepal vs Bahrain
match.h2h:
In official T20
I and ODI formats, Nepal and Bahrain have never faced each other in senior men's cricket.
However, they have an established history in historical lower-division tournaments, women's cricket, and an upcoming ACC fixture.
Senior Men's Cricket Historical Meetings
While they have not met in highest-level modern formats (
ODIs/
T20
Is), they have played once in ICC regional pathway tournaments:
February 23, 2010 (
ICC World Cricket League Division Five): Nepal won by 8 wickets. Bahrain was bowled out for 114 runs, and Nepal chased it down comfortably (115/2) behind a player-of-the-match performance from Paras Khadka.
